selection_rule: Expanded final comparison only. Prefer net rescued/harmed across order seeds and all-seed CC/WW, up to two distinct queries each; prioritize available partial-missing coverage in second slots. Rank by absolute net rescue count, then absolute fixed-rival margin change and ID; representative seed has largest absolute margin change within state. Fill unavailable categories by transition then margin. Outcome-selected, not representative prevalence.
